categories.main_business_segments: Toukei Computer Co., Ltd. operates three main business segments: (1) Information Processing and Software Development (including software development, system operation, and facility services), (2) Equipment Sales (mainly hardware related to developed systems), and (3) Leasing and Other Businesses (including OA equipment leasing/rental and real estate leasing). The core segment is information processing and software development, which accounts for the majority of revenue and profit.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in industry-specific system integration, custom software development, and packaged software solutions. It leverages accumulated industry know-how, cloud computing, IoT, and advanced information security management (ISMS-certified data centers). Production methods include individual project-based software development, system operation outsourcing, and the use of proprietary IT assets for scalable product licensing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Toukei Computer serves a diverse range of industries, including manufacturing, distribution, logistics, construction, real estate, finance, and public sectors. Its key customers are Japanese enterprises seeking IT system integration, operational outsourcing, and digital transformation solutions, with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Japan, with its headquarters in Kawasaki and multiple offices across the country (including Tokyo, Nagoya, Chiba, and others). It also has offshore and support subsidiaries in China (Dalian) and Thailand to support Japanese companies with overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Toukei Computer is positioned downstream in the IT services supply chain, directly providing end-to-end solutions, system integration, and operational services to client enterprises. It also acts as a value-added reseller for hardware required by its systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding sales of proprietary IT asset-based service products, enhancing packaged software offerings, and increasing recurring revenue from system operation and licensing. The company invests in R&D for IoT, cloud, and new technologies, and emphasizes employee skill development and innovation to support long-term growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of project-based software development, recurring system operation and outsourcing contracts, packaged software licensing, hardware sales, and equipment leasing. Increasing focus is placed on scalable product licensing and recurring service revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Toukei Computer competes with other Japanese system integrators and IT service providers, such as large SIers and specialized software firms. It differentiates itself through deep industry expertise, proprietary packaged solutions, and a strong reputation for reliability and security, maintaining a stable and profitable position in the mid-sized enterprise IT market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending December 2024, consolidated sales reached approximately 19.6 billion yen, with operating profit of 5.6 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of 4.5 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in both revenue and profit over the past five years, with high equity ratios (over 80%) and a focus on stable, sustainable expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Toukei Computer emphasizes its ability to deliver industry-specific, high-quality IT solutions with rapid deployment and cost efficiency, leveraging proprietary IT assets and packaged software. Its strengths include deep domain expertise, robust security, flexible customization, and a track record of reliable system operation, enabling clients to achieve digital transformation and operational efficiency.
